verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show programmatic conversion flows: Bridge orchestration supports on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows; the fiat-to-crypto onramp lets customers purchase and exchange crypto; and Stripe converts automatically for stablecoin payouts and for payments that settle as fiat. None of the evidence documents a quote API, exchange rates, fee schedules, or settlement-time guarantees, so only executed conversion is evidenced. Missing for 10: a quote/rate-lock API, documented conversion rates and fees, documented settlement times, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversion APIs.

support.subject: As a developer, conversion is a first-class API — quotes and executed conversions between fiat and stablecoins (and between stablecoins) with documented rates, fees, and settlement times

citations.quote: Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.
The Stripe fiat-to-crypto onramp lets your customers securely purchase and exchange cryptocurrencies directly from your platform or decentralized application (Dapp) at checkout.
Your platform balance stays in fiat currency, while Stripe handles conversion and payout.
completed payments settle in your Stripe balance in your local currency.
